name: Withings
short_desc: External: connect Withings so Health and your agent get sleep, activity and workouts (read-only). Needs your own free Withings developer application.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Connect your Withings with a guided setup inside the app. Needs your own developer credentials: a free Public API integration application you create on the Withings Developer Dashboard (the app shows every value to copy). The app keeps a private synced copy and offers it read-only to other apps on this box through the health-data contract; the Health app shows sleep, activity (intensity minutes) and workouts. Withings has no recovery score. Keys and sign-in stay in the app.
